title.zh: 方程与天平 · 两边同做一件事
title.en: Equations as a balance · do the same to both sides

description.zh: 等号像一架平衡天平的指针：等式两边一样重，只要对两边同时加、减、乘、除同一个数（不除以 0），天平就保持平衡；解方程就是用这一招把未知数 x 单独留在一边。
description.en: The equals sign is like the needle of a balanced scale: both sides weigh the same, and adding, subtracting, multiplying or dividing both sides by the same number (never dividing by 0) keeps it balanced; solving an equation means using that one move to leave the unknown x alone on one side.

what does the equals sign mean

label.zh: 消元也是两边同做一件事
label.en: Elimination is still doing the same to both sides

reason.zh: 解方程组时的代入和加减消元，每一步仍是对等式两边做同样的事；先会把一个方程里的 x 单独留下，才能处理两个方程两个未知数。
reason.en: Substitution and elimination in a system are still doing the same thing to both sides of an equation; you must first be able to isolate x in one equation before handling two equations in two unknowns.

label.zh: 平衡的天平与倾斜的天平
label.en: A level scale and a tilted one

reason.zh: 等式是平衡的天平，解是一个数；不等式是倾斜的天平，解是一整段。两边加减同一个数对两者都成立，但两边乘除一个负数时不等号要翻转，等式却不受影响。
reason.en: An equation is a level scale with a single-number solution; an inequality is a tilted scale whose solution is a whole range. Adding or subtracting the same amount works for both, but multiplying or dividing by a negative flips an inequality while leaving an equation unchanged.
